segments.text: Long ago, before the kingdoms of the north were founded, a small village stood at the edge of a
great forest. The people there were farmers and woodcutters, and every autumn they gathered in
the square to share the harvest. One year a stranger arrived with a map drawn on the skin of a dragon.
He said that a tower stood in the middle of the forest, and that a library was hidden beneath it,
full of books that no one had read for a thousand years.
Three young friends decided to follow the map.
The first was a hunter who could track a deer through snow.
The second was a healer who knew every herb in the valley.
The third was a storyteller who remembered every song her grandmother had sung.
They walked for nine days, crossed two rivers, and climbed a hill covered in white stones
before they finally saw the tower rising above the trees.
